candidate.field: unchanged Universal Field v1 single-level primitive query features shared with LERF2D
candidate.base_readout: kNN10 then per-query scene minmax then clip(2u-1,0,1), fixed primitive threshold 0.6
candidate.typed_extent: compute the 8-connected projected component containing the rendered query-score peak; accept it only when it retains at least 25 percent of the original projected support, otherwise return the original support
candidate.threshold_rationale: A conservative quarter-support invariant prevents a single peak from deleting more than three quarters of the frozen prediction. It is global and dimensionless.

evidence_boundary.reason: The candidate was motivated and screened after Waldo's unconditional-peak regression was known. Independent rerunning can verify implementation and reproducibility but cannot restore blindness.
